dataset.name: Lung adenocarcinoma (CPTAC-GDC, 2025)
dataset.description: Independent CPTAC lung adenocarcinoma cohort with GDC-derived bulk RNA-seq TPM and GDC survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC primary lung adenocarcinoma; an external proteogenomic cohort not pooled with TCGA-LUAD or the separate CAS cohort.

metadata.source_data_system: NCI GDC via the cBioPortal public API and GDC survival API
metadata.redistribution_note: The cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but raw matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TPM expression and survival are joined by immutable patient submitter ID. All selected samples are primary solid tumors with LUAD OncoTree coding; one participant has two profiles and is resolved by the repository's deterministic one-sample rule.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The cBioPortal GDC profile supplies non-negative TPM values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Initial diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
